---
name: Feature request
description: Suggest a new capability, workflow, template, checklist, or pack improvement
title: "Feature: "
labels: [enhancement, needs-triage]
assignees: []
---

## Summary
Describe the improvement you want to add to the AI Engineer Pack.

## Problem or opportunity
What user need, contributor pain, assistant limitation, or documentation gap does this address?

## Proposed solution
Explain the change in enough detail for maintainers to evaluate it. Include proposed folders, files, headings, workflows, or examples when useful.

## Scope
Select all that apply:

- [ ] New command
- [ ] New framework documentation
- [ ] New skill category
- [ ] New technology-specific skill
- [ ] New template
- [ ] New checklist
- [ ] New example
- [ ] Repository automation or community health
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Other

## Target users
Who benefits from this feature?

- [ ] ChatGPT users
- [ ] Codex users
- [ ] GitHub Copilot users
- [ ] OpenAI Agents users
- [ ] Future AI coding assistants
- [ ] Human maintainers
- [ ] New contributors

## Example usage
Show how someone would use the new content. For example:

```text
Use the deploy command with the Kubernetes skill to prepare a production rollout plan with health checks and rollback steps.
```

## Alternatives considered
List any simpler, narrower, or existing pack resources that could solve the same need.

## Acceptance criteria
A complete implementation should include:

- [ ] Production-quality Markdown.
- [ ] Clear purpose, usage, and related links.
- [ ] Examples where useful.
- [ ] No placeholders or generic filler.
- [ ] Cross-links to relevant commands, skills, frameworks, templates, or checklists.

## Contribution notes
If you plan to submit a pull request, read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and keep the change narrowly scoped.
